stated: Set a target of ending deep poverty within a decade, and establish an independent commission to recommend further annual increases in Universal Credit to ensure that support covers life’s essentials, such as food and bills.

source.quote: Set a target of ending deep poverty within a decade, and establish an independent commission to recommend further annual increases in Universal Credit to ensure that support covers life’s essentials, such as food and bills.

bearing_set.reason: The policy explicitly targets covering food and bills through mandated annual Universal Credit increases, directly affecting real disposable income and ability to afford essentials for the lowest-income households.
Universal Credit supports people both in and out of work; raising its floor to eliminate deep poverty directly bears on the in-work poverty indicator under good work and fair pay.
Targeting deep poverty and raising UC for the bottom of the income distribution directly narrows the gap between richest and poorest — a clear Gini/poverty-depth effect.

Annual UC increases recommended by an independent commission represent ongoing additional expenditure; if unfunded, they materially affect the debt path — a concrete fiscal cost mechanism on one of the UK's largest benefit programmes.

membership_note: Policy bears on essentials affordability (O2), inequality narrowing (O14), and public finances (O12); O4 (work incentives) and O11 (tax burden) are adjacent but the primary mechanism is benefit adequacy for non-workers in deep poverty, not labour-market quality or tax rates.
